metadata.description: Applied AI marketplace: the Brain knowledge engine, the kb knowledge-worker plugin, Scribe living documents, Taska work tracking from meetings, and the consult research and deck factory.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Build, maintain, and deploy the Brain: a local, truthful knowledge engine (RAG + taxonomy graph + deterministic marts) over docs + spreadsheets, served via a governed MCP.

plugins.name: kb
plugins.description: Knowledge-worker companion over the Brain: cited answers and Markdown deliverables.

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Living documents over the Brain: scheduled, versioned, cited docx/pdf with claim-level lineage.

plugins.name: taska
plugins.description: A manager's Epic > Story > Task tree kept current from meetings, calendar and files: cited evidence, dependencies, staleness and asks.

plugins.name: consult
plugins.description: Guided consulting research from onboarding to a reviewed deck: hypotheses, coached research, customer-test synthesis, rule-gated decks.
